📜 MARKET HISTORY: BLACK THURSDAY On 12 March 2020, Bitcoin fell about 50% in a day. It was not a crypto event. A pandemic panic was crashing stocks, oil and gold at once, and crypto was the most sellable thing a lot of people held. The drop was violent because it was borrowed. Over $1B of longs were force-closed in 24h, each forced sale feeding the next. On MakerDAO, a jammed network let a bot win collateral for a $0 bid. At the lows, the top exchange went dark for 25 minutes and the cascade paused. The plumbing that broke got rebuilt.
